name: The two reserve police guards (unnamed)
role: Bridge guards, in on the plan

known.fact: One whistles "Det var en lørdag aften" as the all-clear when a stray shot nearly aborts the mission, having already phoned the main guard to check.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: They surrender their pistols for appearances, are tied to a post out of blast range. One of their pistols later hangs Oluf Kroer.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

known.fact: What happened to them afterwards is a loose thread. Straarup: tied up after the charges were laid; info board: before.
known.source: CHARACTERS.md v1 (Straarup, RAHS 2020; research notes; Knud Birk memoir; Randers Kommune info board)

invented: Ole identifies the whistle as a quarter-tone flat, the way that constable always whistles it.
